propositions: four code-review steps (base, round_a, round_b, coach) inherit cfg.model implicitly instead of declaring per-pass model class
step-level model declaration does not reach the resolver at runtime for code-review gate despite YAML carrying correct class tokens
batch steps require model_ladder inside batch sub-dict, not step-level model key, but this constraint is not enforced or documented
verifier downgrade from opus to sonnet on pass-2/pass-4 stops applying when cfg.model is any non-default model due to equality test conflating operator override with provider change
completion.py:332 has identical inversion risk as verify.py:269, affecting completion verifier downgrade
no single env var can express four-pass model mapping (pass-1 frontier, pass-2 standard, pass-4 standard) on non-default providers
